selection.range_transport: https://hf-mirror.com (redirects to official Hugging Face Xet CDN)
selection.real_selection_rule: First 96 complete <=16MiB triplets sorted by SHA256(mari-comparison-20261101:folder) from Real-world2.zip; no model inference used
selection.asset_selection_rule: All 200 unique Material IDs from official Latest offset=0 and offset=100 pages, in API order, fixed before inference
selection.primary: Official real pairs with provided mask; 96 paired spheres plus 200 CC0 distractors
secondary: 200 flat-color queries against the same 200 ambientCG spheres
selection.training_overlap: Official real pairs may be used to train the released checkpoint. Training membership and per-ID split unknown; this is in-domain diagnostic, not held-out generalization or official test benchmark.
selection.duplicates: Collapse exact query+mask duplicates; include all corresponding exact-output duplicates as relevant. Report QC before model runs.
selection.failure_policy: Network/image failures are reported; no replacement based on inference outcomes.
